scope: Gate 4 schema, nullability, uniqueness, JSON-shape, policy-row, route-validation, startup-validation, fail-closed, and restart/concurrency mapping for incident, compiler, recovery, workflow, lifecycle, dispatch, and audit surfaces.
verificationMode: Source and migration inventory only. PG17 pg_catalog proof and HTTP restart/concurrency proof still require the disposable live-shape clone named by gate-4-done.md.

globalAssumptions.statusAuthority: Status semantics are not accepted from TypeScript enum fallbacks. Consumers must resolve lifecycle_state_definitions through lifecycle_resource_bindings, runtime_semantic_entries dispatchable filters, or resource_runtime_policies as applicable.
globalAssumptions.jsonAuthority: JSONB columns are storage contracts only unless the consumer validates required object/array shape before use. Missing or malformed policy JSON must fail closed.
globalAssumptions.cloneRequirement: Any catalog verdict marked CLONE_PROOF_REQUIRED must be verified against the same disposable PG17 live-shape clone used by Gate 2, never against production.
globalAssumptions.routeScope: GET incident/audit readback may be production read-only evidence. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE route behavior must be clone-only evidence under egress deny.
globalAssumptions.noMutationEvidence: This inventory did not mutate live data and did not execute phone/ADB, release, deploy, Umbrel, or restart actions.
